summary: Independent third-round precommit review of the staged working artifact at /home/hermes/projects/steuerpendler-destinations passed with no identified new security concerns or blocking logic defects. Reviewed the staged production changes in src/municipality-search.ts, src/map-navigation.ts, src/main.ts, src/destinations.ts and src/map.ts, their regression tests, associated styling/strings and release-input metadata against the active scope clarification. Source was treated as inert data. Autocomplete pointerdown now only prevents mouse focus changes and does not choose an option; touch pointerdown remains uncancelled so native scrolling can proceed. Compatibility mousedown prevents premature blur, completed click/tap chooses, and explicit keyboard Enter chooses only from an open list. Refresh clears stale aria-activedescendant. Independently executed the real Chromium touch regression: touchstart leaves selection unchanged, swipe produces positive list scrollTop with no click/selection, and completed tap selects Aarau. Mouse option selection and keyboard workplace/residential selection also passed. The map's gestureMoved latch persists through stationary holds, and release establishes the suppression deadline; the regression involving a 650 ms stationary hold after dragging passed without changing selection. Ordinary municipality mouse clicks, keyboard selection, bounded zoom/reset, wheel zoom, mouse pan, real CDP pinch/touch pan, viewport preservation and 400 px layout tests passed. Independently executed npm test: 26/26 tests across 11 files passed; npx tsc --noEmit exited zero; npm run release:test: 1/1 passed; npx playwright test: 16/16 passed against its production-build web server. git diff --cached --check exited zero. Added-line scans found no matching hardcoded secrets or dangerous execution primitives, and reviewed changes introduce no runtime external service. Verified staged municipality authority and all eight tax profiles are byte-identical to HEAD; independently counted 2,110 residences across 26 cantons. The 19-capital workplace subset is separate from the complete municipality authority used for map, residential search and tax/ranking processing. Existing missing real travel data, numerical accuracy failures and official/owner approval holds are not certified or waived by this review; local UI/regression success is not official financial validation, source CI approval, deployment approval or production readiness. No repository source edits or commits were made by this reviewer; the requested report is the sole authored deliverable. An unstaged docs/map/navigation-verification.md change appeared during read-only checks and was not edited or included in the staged verdict.
